explanation:
The central tree is reduced from 127 lines / 9,419 characters to 87 lines / 6,420 characters: approximately 32% less by both measures. Six peripheral trees expand input isolation, execution, linked-output ownership, comparison records, experiment coordination and promotion. They mix modular boundaries, calls, ownership and data dependencies; connecting edges indicate conceptual expansion, not execution order. Positions were checked against actual text dimensions, and endpoints use meaningful 1-based lines.

Details added from the supplied source include checkpoint ancestry stripping, prompt-lineage exceptions, comparison input limits, Judgement tombstones, persisted experiment launch receipts, whole-source-canvas dependency traversal during diagram promotion, and placement backfill.

Corrections and qualifications: EvalPromptService versions changes to template bases or explicit parents as well as stage text; metadata-only edits need not create versions. EvalRunService imports legacy roll-ups during initialization, while migrate handles older generated views. AgentContextEvalRuntime's cleanup guarantee is scoped to its protected execution block, rather than the seed's unqualified 'every exit'. Runtime exceptions bypass generateValidated's validation retries. Session context delivery is restricted to diagram-change-proposal by evalRunRequestSchema. GeneratedCanvasCatalog permits records without generation metadata and excludes unfinished generation when that metadata exists.

Evidence is limited to context.json and seed.json. The few-shot schedule is supported by evalWorkflows and preparation checks, but its executor implementation was not supplied. Likewise, history coordination, fallback runtime internals, several validators/materializers and publication storage are represented only through their supplied contracts and call sites; their internal behavior is not independently established.

|   `-- CompareSessionService.capture -> independent CompareCanvasCopy
|       |-- Source identity: documentId + optional viewId + checkpointId
|       |-- Selected checkpoint + required revisions; new context, empty undo/redo
|       `-- Clone presentation/provenance; reject unavailable or changed selections

|   |-- requestId + request hash -> reuse a run or reject conflicting reuse
|   |-- Normally expand cells as prompt x sample x workflow stage
|   |   |-- Save queued run before launching background work

|   |   |   `-- Optional layout template selects the template materializer

|   |   |-- linked-canvases: context + optional canvas set -> retained output bundle

|   |-- EvalRuntime boundary -> file fallback or independent AgentContext session
|   `-- generateValidated -> validator/materializer -> accept or retry

|-- Retain outputs using shared canvas and revision types

|   |   |-- saveMappingDiagram(type=generated) -> project representation catalog
|   |   `-- Pin provenance, canvasId, checkpointId, output and placement snapshots

|   |   |-- Clone existing histories; create new diagrams through shared controllers
|   |   |-- Validate exact input coverage, edits, jumps and reachability from root

|   |-- captureOutputResult -> attach a change-session result to an eligible cell
|   |   `-- Check project/version and output vacancy; no acceptance or generation
|   `-- Compatibility: record chat alternatives, migrate views, import old roll-ups
|-- Compare retained outputs
|   |-- CompareSessionService: capture -> createPinned -> saved independent session
|   |   |-- Canvas panes carry camera/focus pairs
|   |   `-- Diagram panes pin revisions and optional ranges or subtree targets
|   |-- ComparisonGenerationService: capture inputs before calling the model
|   |   |-- Pin diagram ASCII, revision IDs, evaluator prompt and prompt version
|   |   |-- Ordinary result: validate pairs and cover every selected alternative
|   |   `-- Experiment result: resolve and persist a comparison report
|   `-- JudgementService -> independently typed durable assessments
|       |-- Reconcile sessions/jobs; retain native progress and deterministic results
|       `-- Own attachments; subjects identify snapshots and resolved run/output keys
|-- Organize experiments -- ExperimentService
|   |-- Cases + conditions + phases + samples + stage outputs

|   |-- Planned generation: prepareForReview pins inputs without launching a job
|   |   |-- Map every planned cell exactly once -> awaiting-approval
|   |   `-- Persist approval -> starting -> launchPrepared -> started; resumable
|   |-- Approved plans and sample/input assignments remain fixed
|   |-- Deterministic assessment reads finished cells' retained proposalTree text
|   `-- Edited relaunch -> immutable prompt fork + new run + next sample attempt
|-- Promote completed evidence -- promoteOutput / prepareOutputPromotion
|   |-- Resolve history artifact, frozen output result or pinned canvas checkpoint
|   |-- Select bundle/canvas/diagram; copy reachable canvas dependencies
|   |-- Destinations: new canvas project group, new canvas or existing canvas
|   |   `-- Existing destination must be current and settled, without unsaved edits
|   |-- Remap jumps and record generated-to-promoted placement bindings

`-- Keep records navigable and consistent

    |-- Restart: fail active ordinary cells; retain completed canvases
    |   |-- Exempt diagram-history runs for their external coordinator
    |   `-- Comparison jobs recover a saved report/session, otherwise fail
    `-- EvalsPage -> prompts, outputs, experiments, comparisons and Judgements

        `-- Poll active work; refresh generated outputs as cells complete

Pinned evidence and visibility boundaries
|-- EvalPromptService exposes save / resolve / fork / snapshot
|   |-- Private write queue serializes prompt changes
|   |-- Version changes: stage hash, template base or explicit parents
|   |   `-- Name/description edits alone retain the version
|   |-- Lineage rejects cycles and missing parent versions
|   |   `-- Exception: diagram-history may derive from change proposals
|   `-- resolve freezes cited reference text when the run is prepared
|       `-- Missing reference fails resolution
|-- CompareSessionService.capture owns independent input copies
|   |-- Prefer available generated snapshot for a checkpoint
|   |-- Workspace selection must still match head or saved view endpoint
|   |-- copyCompareHistory keeps one checkpoint and rendering revisions
|   |   |-- Strip checkpoint parentId and transactionId
|   |   |-- New contextId; baselineId = headId = selected checkpoint
|   |   `-- Missing revision parents become revisionBoundary entries
|   `-- Preserve view/provenance; validate workspace presentation
|-- EvalRunService binds generation ownership
|   |-- Context inputs retain ID/name/hash; execution verifies hash
|   |-- Canvas-only runs create a context describing pinned inputs/prompts
|   `-- Rerun pins may be reused; root run remains the context owner
`-- createPinned clones captured copies again for the session
    `-- Later source edits do not replace the selected evidence

Execution and session lifetime
|-- EvalRunService owns scheduling and validation
|   |-- Private starts/preparedLaunches maps coalesce concurrent launches
|   |-- Save queued run -> create AbortController -> execute a live clone
|   |-- Ordinary chains run with configured concurrency (default 3)
|   `-- Session context delivery: proposal workflow only, one chain at a time
|-- AgentContextEvalRuntime implements EvalRuntime
|   |-- No agentContext -> delegate to CodexEvalRuntime
|   |-- Resolve context messages before creating an independent session
|   |-- Disable tools, skills, extensions, context files, retry and compaction
|   |-- Persist independent session identity; route identical prefixes together
|   |   |-- Cache key includes provider, model, effort, system prompt and hash
|   |   `-- SSE avoids shared WebSocket conversation state
|   |-- Prompt = composed text + serialized supplementary files
|   |-- Parse JSON if possible; otherwise return raw text for validation
|   `-- Protected execution exits run finally cleanup
|       `-- Clear timer/listener, unsubscribe, dispose and remove session
`-- generateValidated owns bounded validation retries
    |-- Runtime call occurs outside the validator catch
    |   `-- Runtime failure is not retried by this loop
    |-- Validation failure adds previous-output.json + validation-error.json
    |-- At most 3 calls; usage sums across responses on success
    `-- Successful result carries the final response's execution identity

Linked output bundle ownership
|-- materializeLinkedCanvases validates the complete graph in memory
|   |-- Unique output IDs; every input canvas appears exactly once
|   |-- Existing canvas -> clone history and capture baseline
|   |   |-- Reject unknown/repeated diagram edits
|   |   `-- Apply replacements, then reanchor edited edges
|   `-- New canvas -> materializeDiagrams; baseline = null
|-- Resolve jumps against the proposed diagrams
|   |-- Jumps must cross canvas boundaries
|   |-- Source span must contain visible text
|   |-- Target line requires a diagram and a recognized concept node
|   |-- Store source revision/hash and resolved target identities
|   `-- Directed reachability from rootCanvas must cover all canvases
|-- Shared MappingDocumentController owns staged edits
|   |-- Replace every diagram's jump list, including empty lists
|   |   `-- Old links cannot escape into live canvases
|   `-- Export revisions and proposed state; put root canvas first
`-- EvalRunService retains the returned clone
    |-- outputResults[cellKey] = complete EvalOutputResult
    |-- Cell stores summary, explanation, usage and terminal status
    |-- Bundle includes baselines, proposed documents and placement snapshot
    `-- Linked generation does not call saveMappingDiagram here

Comparisons become durable Judgements
|-- Manual create -> capture -> createPinned
|   |-- Diagram panes check revision, range end and subtree existence
|   `-- Canvas self-comparison may auto-focus the first three diagrams
|-- Model prepare captures evidence before generation
|   |-- Require at least one diagram in every selected canvas
|   |-- Limit input to 80 diagrams and 2,000,000 ASCII characters
|   `-- Pin evaluator prompt/version and assign local D1, D2, ... IDs
|-- Model execute has two result paths
|   |-- Ordinary pairs: known IDs, bounded slices, distinct alternatives
|   |   `-- Every selected copy used -> createPinned from original capture
|   `-- Experiment: resolveComparisonReport -> persist report directly
|-- JudgementService reconciles sessions, jobs and eval runs
|   |-- Distinct records: diagram-comparison / canvas-comparison / report
|   |-- Prefer generated runId; otherwise search cells by canvasId
|   |-- Resolve outputKey from owning cell when possible
|   |-- Comparison attachments shrink to the copies actually used
|   `-- Fingerprints avoid reimporting unchanged finished results
`-- Judgement lifetime
    |-- Deletion writes deletedAt; reconciliation does not resurrect it
    |-- Deleting an active imported judgement cancels its comparison job
    `-- Missing legacy comparison source tombstones imported judgements

Experiment review, launch and assessment
|-- ExperimentService.save serializes changes
|   |-- Check expectedRevision and request hash
|   |-- Validate case context hashes and referenced run cells
|   |-- Judgement subjects must fit the selected comparison
|   |   `-- A Judgement cannot have a home in another experiment
|   `-- prepareForReview captures planned runs into the experiment record
|       |-- Every planned cell maps exactly once to a sample/stage

|-- approve owns a resumable launch sequence
